title: Storm Sorceress
description: A pale-skinned sorceress with flowing dark hair and a red-pink dress floats above a stormy swamp, wielding a glowing blue orb staff in her right hand while summoning a swirling waterspout with her left. Below her is a dark, flooded landscape with lily pads, pink lotus flowers, broken ships, and a dramatic sky filled with purple-black clouds and lightning.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a pale sorceress with long flowing dark hair wearing a red and pink dress, levitating above a dark swamp filled with lily pads and pink lotus flowers. She holds a glowing blue orb staff in one hand and summons a large swirling waterspout with the other. Broken wooden ships are scattered in the water. The sky is filled with turbulent purple and black storm clouds with bright lightning strikes. Cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
